question: Should OpenClaw accept `gateway.reload.autoRestartOnRequired` plus always-on hot-mode restarts for gateway auth, auth-profile/order, and provider SecretRef rotations as the public reload contract?
rationale: This changes a compatibility-sensitive config/default surface and unattended restart behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent operator contract.

options.title: Approve the split contract
options.body: Keep routine hot-mode edits warn-and-keep by default, allow opt-in automatic restart, and always restart security-critical auth/provider credential changes after docs and proof are aligned.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics or writer intent
options.body: Avoid the new global config key and rely on explicit writer restart intent or drift diagnostics for the reported doctor/configure flows.

options.title: Preserve old hot semantics
options.body: Reject unattended hot-mode restarts and require operators to use `hybrid`, manual restart, or a later migration path.

recommendation.title: Approve the split contract
recommendation.body: Keep routine hot-mode edits warn-and-keep by default, allow opt-in automatic restart, and always restart security-critical auth/provider credential changes after docs and proof are aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the original hot-reload behavior and reload planner contract.
